title: EvoProposal
description: Exit contract for m_evo_propose: one bounded candidate edit to the mutable surface of a harness genome. Every field feeding the fabrication-rate metric is machine-checkable: evidence_ptr entries must resolve to real files in archived runs, and diff_ref must resolve to the actual diff artifact. A declared artifact_audit verifies both.

diff_ref.description: Path (relative to the mission dir) of the candidate patch directory: overlay_patch/ holds full replacement files (overlay-relative), deletions.json lists overlay-relative paths to remove. File-level representation keeps the frozen-path check a pure path-set operation (M-D1 plan, revision 1).

mechanism.description: The specific recurring failure pattern this edit targets (Self-Harness style: minimal edit tied to one mechanism), stated falsifiably.

evidence_ptr.description: Resolvable pointers (run-relative path, optionally #Lstart-Lend) into failure traces that exhibit the claimed pattern. Unresolvable pointers are a fabrication signal, not a formatting issue.

predicted_gain_pp.description: Proposer's predicted held-in gain in percentage points. Compared mechanically against the verifier's measured gain for the fabrication-rate metric (PREREG thresholds).

touches_frozen_paths.description: Proposer's own declaration; the frozen-path guard recomputes this independently — a false 'false' here is itself a ledgered integrity violation.

proposed_by.description: seat:<agent_key> — must hold the evo_proposer role; RBAC-checked.
